title: ACE Gallagher acquires UPI Brokers, strengthening its presence in Kuwait
summary: Strengthens ACE Gallagher’s existing presence in Kuwait and supports the Group’s strategy of expanding across its core GCC markets

contentHtml:
Left to Right - Nagib Bahous, Chairman of ACE Gallagher Holding; Ibrahim Arqawi, Executive Director, ACE Gallagher Kuwait. Image Courtesy: ACE Gallagher Kuwai

Strengthens ACE Gallagher’s existing presence in Kuwait and supports the Group’s strategy of expanding across its core GCC markets

Press Release

Kuwait: ACE Gallagher Holding announces the acquisition of United Partners Insurance Brokers (“UPI Brokers”), a well-established insurance brokerage in Kuwait.

The acquisition strengthens ACE Gallagher’s existing presence in Kuwait and supports the Group’s strategy of expanding across its core GCC markets. Over more than three decades, UPI Brokers has built a strong reputation for serving many of Kuwait’s leading business groups. The combination brings together UPI Brokers’ established local relationships and market expertise with ACE Gallagher’s regional capabilities, specialist resources and international reach.

As part of the acquisition, Ibrahim Arqawi will join ACE Gallagher Kuwait as Executive Director, helping lead the business’s continued growth and diversification. Arqawi brings 31 years of insurance experience across several GCC markets. He has also served on the boards of a number of regional insurance companies and remains an active adviser on insurance matters.

“Kuwait is a strategic market for our regional growth, and this acquisition represents an important step in advancing that ambition. What distinguishes UPI Brokers is the trust and reputation it has built in Kuwait over more than three decades. By combining that strong local foundation with ACE Gallagher’s regional capabilities and international reach, we are confident that we can deliver greater value, broader expertise and enhanced service to clients across Kuwait,” said Nagib Bahous, Chairman of ACE Gallagher Holding.

“After more than three decades in the Kuwaiti market, continuity and trust remain fundamental to our relationships with clients and colleagues. Joining ACE Gallagher enables us to preserve the qualities that have defined UPI Brokers while gaining access to the scale, expertise and resources required to serve our clients even more effectively. This marks an important new chapter for our business, our people and our clients,” said Ibrahim Arqawi.

The acquisition forms part of ACE Gallagher Holding’s broader strategy to strengthen and expand its presence across key GCC markets while continuing to invest in specialist expertise, local relationships and client service.

About UPI Brokers

United Partners Insurance Brokers Co., W.L.L. (UPI) is a Kuwait-based, independently owned insurance brokerage established in 2013. Over the past decade, UPI has grown to become one of Kuwait’s most respected brokerage firms, serving a distinguished portfolio of public and private sector corporate clients across a broad range of industries.

 Backed by a management team with over 100 years of combined industry experience, UPI offers end-to-end risk advisory services spanning life and non-life insurance, program structuring, policy design, and claims advocacy.

About ACE Gallagher

ACE Gallagher is a leading regional insurance and reinsurance broker with more than 70 years of experience. Through its strategic partnership with Gallagher, one of the world’s largest insurance brokerage, risk management and consulting firms, ACE Gallagher combines deep local market knowledge with international capabilities and specialist expertise.

Operating through 16 offices across seven countries, ACE Gallagher delivers tailored insurance, reinsurance, risk-management and claims solutions to clients across a broad range of industries. Its approach is founded on trusted relationships, responsive service and a thorough understanding of the markets in which its clients operate.
